name: ug-company-formation
description: Forming a company in Uganda, tax year 2026-27: entity types registered by URSB, first steps, URA TIN documents, EFRIS and VAT at the 2026 threshold. Fees and timing from the old file are held as unverified. Use for Uganda questions from URA taxpayers, employers, advisers and foreign investors, including rates, thresholds, filing dates, the URA portal and worked computations. Figures for tax year 2026-27 come from Uganda Revenue Authority pages and the law, and items that could not be opened are named as unverified in the Sources section. Not reviewed by a licensed accountant.
